Use Tier 2 architectural deepening, focusing on model_design and training_evaluation: replace independent history-item representations with locally contextualized representations before the existing attention pooling. The two direct latest-item residual trials both scored 0.6013 versus the parent’s 0.6275, so do not repeat that extension. The current encoder assigns attention to individual item vectors but does not explicitly represent adjacent-item interactions; this is a plausible limitation, not an established explanation for the plateau.

Add one causal width-three temporal convolution over propagated history-item vectors, followed by GELU and a linear output projection, and add its output residually to each history vector. Zero-initialize only the output projection inside an RNG-forked initialization scope to preserve initial parent predictions and the existing training random stream. Compact valid events in chronological order before convolution, left-pad its temporal context with zeros, mask padded outputs, and use the contextualized vectors for both attention keys and pooled values while retaining the existing relative-position embeddings, latest-item attention query, gate, graph propagation and candidate scoring. This single component lets attention select short ordered patterns rather than isolated events, without introducing the previously unsuccessful direct latest-item scoring residual.

Train from scratch with the existing loss, optimizer, sampling, supervised-edge masking, hyperparameters, seed 42 and SASREC_EPOCHS default 200 unchanged, using only the supplied splits with preprocessing seed 0. Update the predictor writer and diagnostics to require strict restoration of the convolution parameters and verify initial parent parity, causal context construction, repeated-item handling, padding invariance, empty-history behavior, finite gradients and serialization parity. Preserve DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, all four category routes and exactly one selected checkpoint per category, with validation and host inference sharing the same encoder. Report the selected checkpoints’ actual local macro HR@10 as Final Validation Score, compare pinned-host validation against 0.6275 using 200 users per category and 99 unique negatives at evaluation seed 42, and leave all test access and final evaluation to the host.
